title: English Teacher
description: Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone. If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week. What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that! In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire: Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements: Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are: Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Customer Retention Specialist
description: About us: Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. We’re building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us? About you: This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Retention Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you’ll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota. What You’ll Own: Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue. You’ll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI. Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines. Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved. Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value. Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured “silent churn” playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces. Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.

High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.G., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting. Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows. ability to identify theroot causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms. Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution;
capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions. Benefits & Compensation Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Arquiteto De Software
description: A VMetrix é uma empresa SaaS que desenvolve uma plataforma financeira integral utilizada por bancos, fundos de pensão, gestoras de fundos, corretoras e asset managers no Chile e na América Latina. Nossa plataforma cobre o ciclo completo de gestão de investimentos: desde a captura de operações e gestão do ciclo de vida transacional, até a precificação, contabilidade, risco de mercado, compliance regulatório e reporting. Propósito do Cargo Arquiteto de Software é responsável por definir, evoluir e governar a arquitetura técnica da plataforma VMetrix. Este papel atua como ponte entre os requisitos de negócio financeiro, as restrições regulatórias e a implementação técnica, garantindo que as decisões arquiteturais suportem a escalabilidade, manutenibilidade e compliance da plataforma a longo prazo. Lidera o design dos sistemas mais complexos, estabelece os padrões técnicos para toda a equipe de desenvolvimento e governa a adoção estratégica de ferramentas de IA no ciclo de engenharia. Responsabilidades Principais: Desenvolvimento e Manutenção da Plataforma Desenvolver e manter módulos core da plataforma: ciclo de vida transacional (captura, validação, aprovação, liquidação), precificação de instrumentos, contabilidade de investimentos, risco de mercado e reporting regulatório. Implementar lógica de negócio financeiro complexa: processos de precificação mark-to-market, cálculos de P&L, accruals, amortizações, simulações end-of-day e processos batch de fechamento. Escrever código bem estruturado, eficiente, testável e aderente aos padrões arquiteturais definidos pela equipe de Arquitetura. Identificar bugs, gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria na base de código, propondo e implementando soluções com foco em qualidade e manutenibilidade. Antecipar necessidades futuras do sistema, sendo proativo na identificação de riscos técnicos e propondo soluções antes que se tornem impedimentos. Arquitetura de Dados e PL/SQL Projetar e otimizar procedures PL/SQL em Oracle 21c, incluindo pipelined functions, estratégias com Global Temporary Tables e packages de cálculo financeiro. Construir APIs REST robustas para integração com sistemas externos (ERPs, sistemas contábeis, provedores de dados de mercado), cobrindo múltiplas classes de ativos. Participar no design de motores genéricos com arquitetura metadata-driven, múltiplas estratégias de execução e cache de alto desempenho. Qualidade, Testes e Revisão de Código Analisar, depurar e testar software de forma sistemática, garantindo conformidade com as especificações técnicas definidas. Realizar revisões de código com foco em qualidade, segurança, performance e aderência aos padrões arquiteturais da plataforma. Definir e aplicar estratégias de testes (unitários, integração, contrato) em colaboração com o time de Arquitetura. Garantir que os módulos desenvolvidos sejam seguros, estáveis e aderentes às exigências regulatórias dos mercados atendidos. Colaboração Técnica e Mentoria Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o Arquiteto de Software e Tech Leads para o cumprimento das diretrizes técnicas e das demandas da área. Realizar mentoria técnica de desenvolvedores juniores e plenos: revisões de design, pair programming e transferência de conhecimento do domínio financeiro. Participar ativamente de reuniões técnicas de equipe para discussão e alinhamento de demandas, soluções e prioridades. Monitorar tendências e tecnologias, contribuindo com propostas de melhoria de processos e ferramentas utilizadas no desenvolvimento dos produtos da empresa. Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA Utilizar ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) de forma produtiva e responsável no ciclo diário de desenvolvimento: geração de código, revisão, debugging e escrita de testes. Elaborar e consumir especificações técnicas otimizadas para uso com LLMs, garantindo que a documentação sirva tanto para a equipe quanto como contexto de alta qualidade para ferramentas de IA generativa. Aplicar engenharia de prompts no contexto de desenvolvimento: formular contextos precisos, decompor problemas e validar criticamente as saídas de modelos de linguagem. Requisitos Técnicos: Formação acadêmica: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou certificações técnicas relevantes são diferenciais. 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software. Domínio avançado de Java 8+ e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, transações, testes). Experiência sólida em Oracle Database (PL/SQL, pipelined functions, partitioning, performance tuning, schemas complexos). Conhecimento prático de Kubernetes (OKE) e deployments em containers (Docker, WebLogic em OKE). Experiência com padrões de arquitetura: metadata-driven designs, cache distribuído (Caffeine/Redis), event-driven, repository pattern. Familiaridade com ferramentas de desenvolvimento modernas: Git e Git Flow, pipelines CI/CD, Postman/OpenAPI. Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA: Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot ou similares — incluindo uso em geração de código, escrita de testes, refatoração e debugging. Capacidade de engenharia de prompts aplicada ao desenvolvimento: saber formular contextos precisos, decompor problemas e validar criticamente as saídas de modelos de linguagem. Capacidade de ler e produzir especificações técnicas detalhadas em formato Markdown. Requisitos Desejáveis: Conhecimento do domínio financeiro: renda fixa, renda variável, derivativos, fundos de investimento, gestão de portfólios, contabilidade de investimentos, risco de mercado. Experiência com regulação financeira brasileira ou latino-americana (CVM, BACEN, ANBIMA, ou órgãos equivalentes). Experiência com integrações Office (Excel Add-ins) para plataformas SaaS financeiras. Familiaridade com padrões da indústria financeira (FpML, ISDA, ou outros). Experiência com observabilidade: Grafana, métricas de aplicação, alerting. Conhecimento de práticas GitOps e versionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC). Familiaridade com testes de contrato (contract testing) e testes de integração em arquiteturas de microsserviços. Certificação Java (OCA/OCP) ou certificações equivalentes em tecnologias do stack. Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas de tecnologia, engenharia ou gestão de inovação. Processo de Candidatura: Candidatura: Candidate-se diretamente pelo LinkedIn. Teste técnico: Os candidatos selecionados receberão uma avaliação técnica online. Esta etapa é obrigatória e parte fundamental do processo. Entrevista com Líder e RH: Uma conversa com a equipe para te conhecer melhor e aprofundar sua experiência. Decisão: Informaremos o resultado com feedback, independentemente de você avançar ou não. Por que trabalhar na VMetrix Na VMetrix, não buscamos “fazer mais barulho”, mas sim construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva. Você fará parte de uma empresa que está redefinindo como as instituições financeiras adotam tecnologia crítica, em um ambiente desafiador, sofisticado e de alto nível profissional. Se você se motiva a construir marca, reputação e relações de longo prazo no coração do sistema financeiro, a VMetrix é o lugar.

title: Technical Product Owner
description: ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams. Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process. WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued. OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

description:
Company Overview: Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Job Overview: The Senior Estimator uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the estimating discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the estimating discipline. The Senior Estimator solves complex problems and uses their discipline-specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Estimator impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the estimating team and other related teams and ensures that they are working within the appropriate guidelines and policies. Job Responsibility: Review, query, and understand the scope of work in order to prepare a proper estimate and direct attention to those areas that appear inconsistent or contain a high-risk element. Support the PMT team to generate the Marine/Offshore Estimate for the Preliminary stage to ensure Bid No Bid. Review the Project Plan along with the project planner and prepare subcontract scope packages for any work that is required to be subcontracted. Gather information and input from functions with support from the Project Manager. Consult with Subject Matter Expert (SME) to discuss Estimates and resolve issues. Generate estimates with available Benchmark data and from experience prior to receiving the inputs from functions and evaluate the estimates received from functions against the internal estimate Liaise with Project Team members plus all functional departments based on the specific functions allotted for a project, subcontractors and vendors, and Customer;
including Procurement,Fabrication, Marine, Quality, HSES, Completions, and Welding Technology Provide input to the Project Estimators, along with Basis of Estimate and Bench Markers Give regular updates to the department manager/PMT /immediate supervisor and highlight any concerns about anything that might potentially jeopardize submitting a competitive proposal. Analyze the cost components that are critical/crucial and seek quotes for applicable items. Participate in Bid review meetings, estimate evaluation meetings, Risk assessment meetings, as well as any additional bid-related meetings, as required. Prepare a comprehensive Basis of Estimate (BOE). Review and identify contract price form. Understand and clarify unit rate and lump sum breakdowns. Accurately manage all the Previous Tender information and Treat it with Confidentiality Utilize support from the benchmarking team (SMEs) by analyzing information on the costs from other similar projects and preparing the relevant benchmark report. Attend and participate in Bid review meetings, estimate evaluation meetings, Risk assessment meetings, etc., as necessary for the Project/Department/Tender Participate in HAZAN, HAZID, HAZOP, and other safety /operability/ reliability studies and workshops, as necessary for Project/Tender Ensure any Risk or Opportunity highlighted is Duly captured for the Management review and approval. Post Tender submission provide input for the clarification. Support bid handover process ensuring proper transfer of pricing basis and critical assumptions to project team. Manage own time to meet objectives;
forecast and plan resource requirements. Incorporate project planner input to develop the cost. Assure that the estimate is: Completed promptly Cognizant of the Bid ‘Win Strategy’ Aligned with planned schedeule All the Risk and Opportunities highlighted. With Due Basis of Estimate Accurate, free of errors, omission, or hidden contingency In line with the agreed execution plan Evaluate and recommend ways to be more cost-effective or profitable Qualifications: Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or related technical discipline preferred. Equivalent experience will be considered. Five plus (5+) years of experience in a large Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) company (preferably in Offshore/Marine Operations, and offshore estimation, ). Subsea/SURF experience with Minimum 3–5 years of direct experience in subsea/SURF construction estimation, including deepwater pipeline installation, flexible/umbilical lay, subsea structure installation, and marine spread costs. Experience with DSV, PLSV, and/or Heavy Construction Vessel (HCV) spread rate estimation strongly preferred. Cost estimation experience, preferably in the Oil & Gas industry Willingness to work overtime as necessary to meet deadlines Intermediate level in Microsoft Office systems, e.G., Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Project Accurately evaluate detailed specifications that are crucial to a cost estimator’s success Must pay attention to minute details because such details may impact a product’s overall cost Must plan their work and work efficiently and accurately.

title: Team Leader | Adidas Nova América
description:
Objetivo e Relevância Global para a Organização: Contribuir para o alcance das metas de KPI da Loja, proporcionando uma experiência memorável para os consumidores e praticando os Valores da Marca. Apoiar a liderança e as operações da loja como terceiro responsável e gerenciar a equipe designada. Utilizar conhecimento e experiência para vender aos consumidores, atendê-los e alcançar excelência operacional, além de executar operações de loja perfeitamente quando for responsável pelo fluxo de produtos entre a área de vendas, o estoque e/ou o caixa, seguindo os procedimentos. Principais Responsabilidades: - Apoiar as operações de vendas da loja e os funcionários como terceiro responsável, cumprindo a função de gerente responsável na ausência do Store Manager e do Assistant Store Manager para assegurar o gerenciamento e a supervisão da loja, garantindo o cumprimento dos padrões de atendimento da adidas.
- Colaborar na obtenção dos KPIs da loja e garantir que a equipe tenha ciência deles e da forma como contribuem, e sugerir ajustes necessários para aumentar a produtividade e a eficiência no atendimento e na área de vendas.
- Contribuir para que as políticas e os procedimentos da loja sejam cumpridos de forma a manter um ambiente de trabalho e de compras seguro e apoiar o treinamento da equipe para garantir os padrões da adidas e reduzir riscos.
- Supervisionar e apoiar as diferentes tarefas da loja (por exemplo, caixa, estoque e vendas), executando-as em conjunto com a equipe, se necessário, para garantir o funcionamento da loja e o atendimento ao consumidor.
- Liderar, motivar a equipe designada e apoiar o recrutamento e o treinamento de outros membros da equipe, fornecendo as ferramentas necessárias para ter performance e atingir os objetivos da loja, garantindo o engajamento dos funcionários, a produtividade e a cultura de alta performance, e liderando pelo exemplo enquanto defensor da Marca, demonstrando consistentemente a cultura para reforçar os valores da adidas.
- Apoiar o Store Manager no treinamento da equipe em todas as ferramentas e soluções de vendas digitais e omnicanais, além de prestar atendimento de pós-venda para garantir uma experiência de compra perfeita.
- Concluir todos os programas de treinamento aplicáveis, incluindo Foundational e Seasonal Brand, além de ter conhecimento sobre o produto, colocando o aprendizado na prática com eficácia.
- Trabalhar sempre priorizando a equipe, em total respeito com todos os colegas e contribuindo ativamente para tornar seu local de trabalho um ambiente inclusivo e acolhedor para todos. Habilidades e Conhecimentos: - Conhecimento de todas as ferramentas e processos operacionais da loja, do funcionamento da loja e de como atingir os KPIs.
- Compreensão dos padrões de Visual Merchandising para impulsionar a conversão através de ações estratégicas.

title: Noc Infrastructure Engineer
description:
ITTConnect is seeking an NOC / Infrastructure Engineer to work remotely from anywhere in Brazil for a client in the US. MUST BE fluent in English. The Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for supporting and maintaining customer IT infrastructure within the Managed Services environment. This role focuses on resolving technical issues, supporting backend infrastructure systems, and collaborating with customer IT teams to deploy and maintain solutions. Infrastructure Engineers combine technical troubleshooting with proactive monitoring and documentation to ensure stable and secure client environments. Key Responsibilities Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to servers, virtualization, storage, and core infrastructure systems. Serve as an escalation point for the IT Support team on complex infrastructure-related incidents. Work directly with customers and their IT teams to support the deployment, configuration, and maintenance of infrastructure solutions. Investigate alerts and system reports to proactively identify potential infrastructure issues and performance risks. Follow established runbooks, procedures, and architectural documentation to resolve incidents. Exercise sound technical judgment when diagnosing and resolving infrastructure issues that may not have predefined solutions. Assist with the creation and maintenance of runbooks, diagrams, and infrastructure documentation. Participate in system maintenance activities such as upgrades, patching, and system health checks. Document incident resolution steps and system changes within internal ticketing and knowledge management systems. Maintain strong communication with internal teams and customers regarding issue status and resolution timelines. Requirements 8+ years of IT experience. MUST BE fluent in English. 3–6 years of experience supporting IT infrastructure in an MSP, enterprise IT, or hosting environment. Experience with Windows or Linux server administration. Experience with virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, etc.). Familiarity with storage, backup, and disaster recovery systems. Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. Experience working within ticketing systems and following structured support processes. Strong documentation and communication skills. Preferred Certifications such as VMware VCP, Microsoft, or cloud infrastructure certifications. Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery models. Experience with enterprise infrastructure technologies including VMware vSphere, Cisco UCS, and Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD). Cloud platform administration experience;
Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Amazon Web Services (AWS) are preferred. Experience with cloud platforms, particularly Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including infrastructure design, administration, and troubleshooting. Administration experience with Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM), and enterprise storage platforms. Familiarity with identity platforms (Active Directory, Okta), firewalls (Palo Alto, Cisco FTD), and backup/disaster recovery solutions is a plus.

About the ProductFor more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.Role OverviewWe are seeking an expert-level, highly skilled Cloud Systems Engineer (DevOps) to serve as a GCP Specialist and technical builder for our Google Cloud ecosystem. This role requires more than administration;
you must be capable ofbuilding architectural change, adjusting systems, and driving modernization efforts. You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of our GCP infrastructure, from complex networking to proactive cost optimization and resource scaling. A key responsibility is leading and running large-scale cloud migration projects, specifically from AWS to GCP.The ideal candidate ensures our Compute Engine environment is lean, fast, and resilient while maintaining secure connectivity using both native and third-party VPN solutions.The role’s primary focus demands deep GCP expertise, but candidates must also possess significant experience with AWS for successful migrationstrategy.Key Responsibilities- Infrastructure & Networking: Configure and maintain robust networking architectures, including Cloud DNS and Cloud NAT.- Linux System Administration: Manage and maintain the operating system environment on Compute Engine instances, including patching, configuration management, user account management, and troubleshooting core system issues.- VPN Management: Build and manage secure tunnels using Cloud VPN, pfSense virtual appliances, and CloudConnexa (OpenVPN) for flexible remote access.- Performance Monitoring: Utilize Google Cloud Operations Suite to monitor Compute Engine health. Identify bottlenecks and tune instances for peak performance.- Resource Management: Oversee persistent disks, snapshots, and storage buckets. Ensure high availability while purging unused resources to maintain environment hygiene.- Cost Optimization: Actively monitor billing dashboards, implement committed use discounts (CUDs), and right-size underutilized instances to maintain a lean budget.- Database Oversight: Provide support for PostgreSQL and Oracle environments, ensuring seamless integration and performance within the GCP ecosystem.- Security & Compliance: Enforce IAM roles and security best practices to protect the project perimeterRequired Qualifications- Certification: Active Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer certification.- Containerization Mastery: Strong expertise with Docker for containerizing applications, managing images, and troubleshooting container runtimes.- Scripting Mastery: High proficiency in Python or Bash for automating routine infrastructure tasks, reporting, and task scheduling.- Networking Expertise: Hands-on experience managing network routing, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs using pfSense and CloudConnexa.- Cloud Migration & Project Leadership: Proven experience leading and running application and data migrations from AWS to GCP. This includes the capability to own the end-to-end migration project life cycle and drive solutions.- Compute Engine Mastery: Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling.- English Proficiency: Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)Nice-to-Have- PostgreSQL Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning.- Oracle Expertise: Experience managing or migrating Oracle database environments.- Data & Analytics: Familiarity with BigQuery.We offer- We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.- Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).- Personal laptop.- Health and wellness package.- Fully remote.As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Sales Ai Agent Builder
description:
Sales AI Agent Builder Role Overview: You will architect and manage a fleet of autonomous Sales Agents that perform end-to-end prospecting, qualification, and meeting scheduling. Unlike traditional Sales Ops, you won't just build workflows;
you will build reasoning systems that research prospects, handle objections, and manage their own "inboxes" to deliver qualified meetings to our SEs. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA. Key Responsibilities: - Autonomous Lead Qualification: Design agents to "vet" inbound leads by querying external data sources and internal CRM history to determine if they meet our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP).
- Inbox Management & Objection Handling: Deploy agents (using LLMs like GPT-4o or Claude) that can read incoming emails, categorize intent, and draft/send context-aware replies to handle common objections.
- Live Sales Assistant (RAG): Build a "Sales Knowledge Base" using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) so agents can instantly reference case studies, pricing, and competitor battlecards during autonomous chats.
- CRM Data Integrity: Ensure agents "write back" all interactions to Salesforce/HubSpot, keeping data clean and attribution accurate without rep intervention. Qualifications: - Experience: 4+ years in Growth or Solutions Engineering in a B2B SaaS environment.
- AI Tooling: Experience with "Agent-as-a-Service" platforms (e.G., 11x, Regie.Ai, Lyzr) or building custom agents via LangChain / LangGraph.
- Sales Stack Mastery: Deep expertise in Salesforce/HubSpot, Salesloft/Outreach, and data providers like ZoomInfo or 6sense.
- Analytical Rigor: Ability to A/B test agent prompts and "reasoning loops" to improve meeting-set rates.

Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as ExactTalent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge. About the Opportunity Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a SaaS platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption. The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience. Responsibilities Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients. Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations. Configure and customize the SaaS platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability. Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live. Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments. Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health. Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability. Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch. Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations. Qualifications At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise SaaS products. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. Strong understanding of SaaS platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles. Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams. Experience using tools such as Wrike, HubSpot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms. Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously. Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle. Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language. Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills. Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.Role Overview:We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!What does day-to-day look like:You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.G. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.Requirements:Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)Analytical Skills: Good research and analytical skillsFeedback Skills: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.Creative Thinking: Creative and lateral thinking abilities.Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.Commitment: Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.Preferred Qualifications:Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.Perks of Freelancing With Turing:Work in a fully remote environment.Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.Offer Details:Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. description: About Turing Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises looking to deploy advanced AI systems. Turing accelerates frontier research with high-quality data, specialized talent, and training pipelines that advance thinking, reasoning, coding, multimodality, and STEM. For enterprises, Turing builds proprietary intelligence systems that integrate AI into mission-critical workflows, unlock transformative outcomes, and drive lasting competitive advantage. About the Role We are looking for an experienced Technical Matcher (recruiter) to manage the end-to-end recruitment delivery for customer-side non-technical and technical roles at Turing. You will be responsible for facilitating sourcing candidates, talent planning, capacity management, and internal supply optimization, while activating external sourcing channels where necessary. Key Responsibilities Act as the single point of contact between the Internal Delivery and Talent Fulfillment teams for assigned projects. Activate external sourcing channels (via partnerships or talent acquisition teams) when internal supply is insufficient. Deliver a strong stakeholder experience, maintaining proactive communication and alignment on timelines and expectations. Working knowledge of LinkedIn Recruiter (good to have) and Google tools (Sheets, Docs, Drive) for tracking and reporting. Data analysis and reporting skills — able to extract insights, identify trends, and drive data-backed decisions. Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills. Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote, fast-paced, and evolving environment. Experience working across global time zones and in cross-cultural teams. Nice to Have Experience in non-technical or technical recruitment delivery or managing customer-side talent fulfillment. Prior experience in startups or high-growth organizations with minimal structure. You will be instrumental in harnessing Dingo’s advanced analytics and AI-driven capabilities to proactively engage client to identify risks before they escalate, ensuring consistently measurable results.With a primary focus on our rapidly growing North and South American customer base, you will combine technical expertise with strong communication skills to deliver timely, trusted advice, strengthening long-term partnerships. In a mining sector increasingly focused on efficiency, sustainability, and predictive maintenance, your work will be a key driver in cementing Dingo’s reputation as the leader in asset health intelligence.Condition Data Analysis & Diagnostics – Review and interpret condition management data from both mobile and fixed plant assets to diagnose component-level risks. Apply domain expertise to determine root causes, assess severity, and prioritize corrective actions based on operational impact, safety, and mission criticality.Rules-Based Analytics Development – Create and refine rules-based analytics to enable swift detection of emerging issues. Ensure diagnostic models and alert parameters support early intervention, reducing downtime and extending component life.Technical Support & Collaboration – Provide expert guidance to Dingo teams on component health assessments, lubrication strategies, and condition management best practices. Act as a trusted technical resource for troubleshooting and advanced diagnostics.Customer Communication & Maintenance Recommendations – Follow up on flagged components or lubricant issues, translating complex technical data into clear, actionable maintenance recommendations for customers. Ensure communications are timely, accurate, and aligned with customer priorities.Quality Observation Reviews – Deliver high-quality, daily observation reviews and actionable insights, consistently applying safety-first principles and considering operational mission criticality.Data Accuracy & System Integrity – Monitor the condition management software database to ensure data accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and maintain the integrity of condition records.Lubricated Component Health Assessment – Evaluate the condition of lubricated components to identify opportunities for extending asset life through on-condition maintenance changes.Customer Engagement & Follow-Up – Organize and lead remote Condition Management follow-up meetings with customers and internal teams to confirm satisfaction, address concerns, and reinforce positive engagement experiences.Diagnostic Tools & Guideline Development – Assist in developing structured diagnostic guidelines, contamination troubleshooting processes, and detailed repair procedures to support consistent, high-quality component health management.QualificationsExperience – Minimum of five (5) years’ experience in heavy industrial equipment maintenance within industrial or mining environments;
OR a Mechanical or Mining Engineering degree with at least two (2) years of relevant experience. Hands-on background as a shop or field mechanic for industrial mining equipment is highly desirable.Industry Knowledge – Strong familiarity with mining and industrial maintenance principles, including mechanical systems, equipment design, and repair processes.Lubrication & Condition Monitoring Expertise – In-depth understanding of lubrication applications, maintenance principles, familiarity in onboard machine telemetry and/or OEM condition monitoring reporting systems, and the use of condition monitoring technologies and tools to inform proactive maintenance strategies.Technical Proficiency – Proven ability to use data and factual analysis to troubleshoot issues, solve problems, and make informed operational decisions.Linguistic Proficiency – Fluency in English is essential for clear and effective communication with customers and internal teams. A high degree of proficiency in Spanish or French is a strong advantage for engaging with a broader range of stakeholders.Communication & Leadership – Excellent verbal and written communication skills, coupled with strong information management capabilities. Demonstrated ability to lead interactions with both internal teams and external customers, building trust and alignment.

title: Analista De Devops Sr
description: About the Company Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider with extensive expertise in cloud, data center, endpoint management and security solutions. Sycomp’s diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company’s mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state-of-the-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 500 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries. Position Overview: We are seeking a motivated and results-oriented Senior Cloud Engineer with experience in two or more cloud technologies (AWS or Azure) to join our growing team in a support, engineering, and consulting role. In this role, you will work closely with our senior architects, engineers and consultants to assist clients in designing, implementing, and optimizing cloud-based solutions. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in cloud architecture, develop technical expertise, and contribute to the success of our clients. What You'll Do: Manage and respond to customer-facing support tickets, ensuring timely resolution of technical issues and maintaining high customer satisfaction. Collaborate with senior architects and consultants to understand client requirements and develop and support scalable cloud-based solutions. Apply best practice framework principles to evaluate and improve client architecture. Apply FinOps best practices to monitor, analyze, and optimize cloud costs, including cost allocation, budget tracking, and implementing cost-saving strategies. Support and assist clients with AI/ML workloads and implementations using cloud provider services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Studio, Azure ML, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, and other AI tools. Assist in designing, implementing, and maintaining cloud infrastructure components such as virtual compute instances (VMs & containers), storage services, databases, and virtual networks (VNet & VPC). Provide technical support to clients, including troubleshooting issues, optimizing performance, and ensuring security best practices. Configure and manage cloud resources, including virtual compute instances, storage services, databases, virtual networks, and more. Develop and document infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like Amazon CloudFormation & CDK, Azure ARM, Azure Bicap, Google Cloud Deployment Manager, or Terraform. Contribute to DevOps workflows using tools such as Azure DevOps, Google Cloud Deployment and Amazon CodePipeline. Maintain awareness and proficiency on cloud services, features, and best practices to provide expert guidance and support to clients. Contribute to the development of documentation, training materials, and best practices guides for internal and external use. Actively participate in professional development activities to enhance technical skills and knowledge of cloud technologies. What We're Looking For: Bachelor's or Technology degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field. At least three years working in an AWS, Azure or Google Cloud environment. At least one professional-level cloud certification such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or Google Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer. Strong understanding of core cloud provider services, including compute, networking, storage, database, and security. Understanding of AWS, and Azure framework principles and practices. Understanding of FinOps principles and cloud cost optimization best practices. Basic understanding of AI/ML concepts and familiarity with AI tools and services. Experience with ticketing systems and customer support workflows. Basic knowledge of networking principles and protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP). Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Fluency in English, both written and verbal. Experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools. Strong written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment. Bonus Points For: Certifications in more than one cloud provider FinOps Certified Practitioner or experience with cloud cost management tools. Experience with cloud provider AI/ML services. Experience conducting Well-Architected best-practice reviews. Knowledge of DevOps principles and practices. Experience in a technology consulting environment. Experience with multiple cloud platforms. What We Offer: Collaborative and inclusive work culture with opportunities for growth and advancement. Exciting projects with leading-edge cloud technologies. Continuous learning and professional development opportunities including training and certification programs. Join our team and embark on a rewarding career journey as a Cloud Engineer, where you will play a vital role in helping our clients succeed in the cloud. title: Operations Assistant - Rezeption & Buchhaltung
description: Über Digital Studio Rio Digital Studio Rio unterstützt gastorientierte Betriebe mit modernen, digitalen Prozessen, klarer Kommunikation und verlässlichen Abläufen. Wir arbeiten serviceorientiert, pragmatisch und strukturiert – mit dem Ziel, dass im Hintergrund alles sauber funktioniert und Gäste sowie Teams sich auf reibungslose Prozesse verlassen können. Deine Mission Du unterstützt unser Team in Rio in einer zentralen Backend-Rolle an der Schnittstelle zwischen Rezeption, Gästeservice und Buchhaltung. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt darauf, dass Buchungen, Folios, Zahlungen, Rückerstattungen und backendseitige Abläufe korrekt und nachvollziehbar bearbeitet werden. Gleichzeitig bist du in der Lage, bei Bedarf auch operativ zu unterstützen und als Backup für die Rezeption bzw. Gästekommunikation einzuspringen. Deine Aufgaben Bearbeitung und Prüfung von Folios, Buchungsdaten und Zahlungsinformationen im Backend Kontrolle, ob backendseitig alle Vorgänge rund um Buchungen korrekt angelegt und verarbeitet sind Bearbeitung von Rückerstattungen, Gutschriften und ähnlichen Zahlungsvorgängen Abstimmung zwischen Rezeption / Gästeservice und Buchhaltung Klärung von Unstimmigkeiten bei Zahlungen, Buchungen oder Abrechnungen Pflege und strukturierte Dokumentation von Abläufen, Informationen und internen Standards Unterstützung bei administrativen Aufgaben rund um Buchungen und Gästeprozesse Bei Bedarf Backup-Unterstützung für die Rezeption, z. B. bei Gästefragen oder operativen Engpässen Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem bestehenden Team in Rio Das bringst du mit Deutschkenntnisse mindestens auf B1-Niveau, schriftlich und mündlich Strukturierte, sorgfältige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise Gutes Verständnis für administrative und backendseitige Abläufe Sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Tools, Systemen und standardisierten Prozessen Fähigkeit, sauber, konzentriert und lösungsorientiert zu arbeiten Bereitschaft, sich in neue Systeme und Abläufe einzuarbeiten Teamfähigkeit und klare Kommunikation Große Vorteile für diese Rolle Erfahrung in Buchhaltung, vorbereitender Buchhaltung oder Abrechnung Verständnis für die Schnittstelle zwischen operativem Betrieb und Finance/Buchhaltung Erfahrung mit Rückerstattungen, Zahlungsabgleichen oder Buchungskontrolle Erfahrung in Hotellerie, Rezeption, Reservierung oder Gästeservice Kenntnisse in DATEV sind ideal, aber keine Voraussetzung Wichtig ist vor allem die Bereitschaft, sich strukturiert einzuarbeiten und Verantwortung zu übernehmen Rahmenbedingungen Remote-Position in Brasilien Idealerweise in Rio de Janeiro Vollzeit, Teilzeit nach Absprache möglich Start: so bald wie möglich Bewerbung Bitte bewirb dich direkt über LinkedIn mit: deinem Lebenslauf auf Deutsch einem kurzen Satz, warum du gut zu dieser Rolle passt Bitte beantworte außerdem auf Deutsch diese 3 Fragen: Wo wohnst du aktuell? Wann kannst du anfangen? Ein Gast schreibt: „Wir kommen heute später an. Können wir trotzdem einchecken?“ Was antwortest du?

title: Emerging Market Trader
description: Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.Key Responsibilities FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-drivenFX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus onAfrican (e.G., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS)orLATAM (e.G., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS)markets. Source and maintaindeep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desksacross relevant regions. Executespot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC tradesto optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitormarket developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamicsacross EM FX markets.Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implementFX hedging strategiesto manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency acrossmultiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity poolswhere relevant. Develop models fordynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhanceFX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automatedhedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity withbanks, ECNs, and liquidity providersvia APIs or FIX protocols. Improveexecution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .Market Development Identify and onboardnew liquidity providers and OTC trading partnersacross emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks forilliquid currency pairsand support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development ofscalable FX infrastructuresupporting global payments and settlement flows.Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experiencein Emerging Markets. Strong experience tradingAfrican or LATAM currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executingOTC and institutional-sized FX trades .Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity withFIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate inhigh-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network withinEM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.Preferred Qualifications Experience supportinghigh-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience tradingEM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity withstablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background inbuilding or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environmentsVision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Clinical Study Manager
description: Job Summary The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia’s headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote. Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials. Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required. Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects. Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines. Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies. Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation. In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.G., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required. Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials. Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable. Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions. Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable. Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product. Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead. Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans. Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.E. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation. Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report. Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites. Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives. Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed. Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets. Education and Experience Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management. Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.G. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.). Experience managing clinical project team personnel. Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies. Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations. Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports. Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process. Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US. Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members. Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a ‘can-do’ attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects. Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus. Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines. Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment. Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers. Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate. Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment. Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment. Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.).. Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers. Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business. Must be fluent in English

title: Forensic Manager
description: This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations. Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery. Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives. In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows. To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business. While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed. For more information, please see our video

What You’ll Be Doing: Collections & Cash Application: - Performs daily collection activities on overdue customer accounts through outbound calls, emails, and correspondence following established dunning schedules and escalation protocols.

documents dispute details and resolution actions in the XERO/Salesforce system.

prepares supporting documentation for bad debt provisions. Credit Analysis & Risk Management: - Performs credit reviews for new and existing customers by analyzing financial statements, credit reports, trade references, and payment history;
recommends credit limits and payment terms.

flags accounts exceeding approved credit limits or exhibiting deteriorating payment behavior.

- Tracks and reports on collection KPIs including collection effectiveness index, roll rates, promise-to-pay conversion rates, and bad debt write-off trends.
- Supports month-end AR close activities including revenue accruals, bad debt provisions, credit memo processing, and sub-ledger-to-GL reconciliation.
- Assists with ad-hoc analysis and special projects as directed by the FP&A Manager or Senior FP&A Analyst. What We’re Looking For: - B.A/B.S. Degree - Accounting or Business Administration;
- 2+ years accountingand/or finance experience, with prior/current internship in accounting;
- Organized, process-oriented and meticulous attention to details;
- Comfortable workingin an entrepreneurial environment and someone who is eager to learn, contribute as a team member and do more and to progress in the company;
