title: Senior Manager, Ocean Policy
description:
Senior Manager, Ocean PolicyConservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.POSITION SUMMARYThis position is open for consideration in the following locations in the Americas, with preference for candidates based in time zones that can accommodate calls with colleagues in Europe and Africa: Arlington-US, Brazil(remote), Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Guyana, Mexico, Suriname, PeruOver the last 10 years, CI has developed a comprehensive Blue Climate program spanning over 20 countries dedicated to identifying and addressing science and policy priorities for oceans and climate globally. The Blue Climate program within the Center for Oceans at CI works closely with our field programs across the Americas, Asia-Pacific and Africa to design and implement innovative approaches to (1) implement nature-based climate adaptation solutions that improve coastal and marine communities’ livelihoods and resilience while also conserving ecosystems and biodiversity;
and (2) conserve and restore coastal blue carbon ecosystems (mangroves, salt marshes, and seagrass meadows) for climate change mitigation. The Blue Climate program also has key leadership roles in advancing climate mitigation and adaptation priorities into national and regional coastal management and science through the International Blue Carbon Institute, Blue Carbon Initiative, the International Partnership for Blue Carbon, the Global Mangrove Alliance and the Global Green-Gray Community of Practice, and policy with the Center for Policy and Incentives.Under the supervision of the Director, Ocean Policy, the Senior Manager, Ocean Policy, is a self-motivated, creative team member integral to the long-term growth and success of CI’s Blue Climate program and Ocean Policy team. The Senior Manager, Ocean Policy will support the development, implementation and management of strategic international policy‑based approaches and programs to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, climate mitigation, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon ecosystems and ocean‑climate integration. Together with the Director, Ocean Policy, they will work with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure alignment with CI’s larger international and national policy programs and priorities, including providing technical inputs and guidance on ocean‑climate issues. The position will also work closely with teams across CI including other programs within the Center for Oceans and the Moore Center for Science and Solutions to ensure alignment and integration of ocean policy priorities with all related CI programs and topic areas, including biodiversity, finance, and community fisheries.RESPONSIBILITIESInternational Ocean Policy- Manage strategic policy initiatives to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon, and other ocean‑climate areas which integrate and align international and national policy goals.- Work closely with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure ocean‑climate strategies and approaches are aligned with international and national policy programs and priorities.- Play a key role in project development, fundraising, implementation, communications, and broader capacity building for the Ocean Policy program.- Contribute to the drafting and revision of CI ocean policy positions, policy briefs, guidance documents, and other technical resources.- Play a key role in representing the Center for Oceans within the CI delegation to international policy meetings related to climate, biodiversity, and oceans, such as the UNFCCC climate COP and intersessional meetings. Additionally, support CI’s strategic engagement in these spaces (e.G., side events, meetings with countries and partners).- Support the development and management of relationships and partnerships with government representatives and like‑minded organizations to accelerate and achieve CI ocean policy objectives in close coordination with CI’s international policy team and relevant country programs.Ocean Policy Advancement in Priority Countries- In partnership with CI country programs, the International Blue Carbon Institute, and the Center for Policy and Incentives, support the development and implementation of national or regional ocean policy objectives and programs which are aligned with and inform CI’s Blue Climate and broader policy priorities.- Provide CI programs and partners with strategic support, technical expertise, and/or capacity building for the integration of coastal ecosystems into Nationally Determined Contributions and implementation plans, national climate and ocean policy, greenhouse gas inventories, NBSAPs and other related components of ocean‑climate policy.- As needed, facilitate in‑person and virtual meetings, workshops, and related events with national governments and local partners to advance the priorities of CI country programs in alignment with national objectives.- Support the Ocean Policy Director in scoping new policy activities in accordance with existing CI programs.Blue Climate Program- Contribute to strategy development, planning processes, fundraising, team initiatives/special projects, reporting and communication efforts as needed.- Coordinate with other teams across the Blue Climate network team to ensure programmatic alignment and synergies between CI projects.Other duties as assigned by supervisor.WORKING CONDITIONS- Frequent international travel (25% or more) is required.- Ability to work in remote locations or under difficult working conditions.- This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some days remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process.- Requires working remotely with colleagues in other locations and time zones.- Flexible working hours: Frequent early morning and evening meetings, and occasional work over weekends, to accommodate colleagues in other time zones or high‑level policy events.- This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process.QUALIFICATIONSRequired- Bachelor’s degree- 5 to 7 years of experience working in international climate and/or ocean policy mechanisms and fora.- Understanding of government processes and the overall policy engagement environment.- Strong organization, project management, and prioritization skills.- Excellent time management skills and ability to adapt in a fast‑paced, changing environment.- Ability to work both independently and as part of a diverse, international team.- Experience partnering with, and influencing, key stakeholders and building strong partnerships across public and private sectors and civil society.- Excellent written and oral communication skills, and ability to effectively communicate complex information to a diverse audience.- Enthusiasm and capacity for learning scientific and related basis for specific conservation outcomes as needed to support policy priorities and processes.- Fluency in written and spoken English.Preferred- Bi‑lingual or multilingual in official UN languages.- Expertise in coastal blue carbon and marine ecosystems, climate change science, and/or nature‑based solutions- Master's degree or other advanced degree in environmental policy or related field.- Experience working globally in a range of cultural settings.To apply for this position, please submit a resume and cover letter.See all Conservation International Career Opportunities HEREConservation International is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. We believe in hiring based on merit and qualifications, ensuring a fair and inclusive hiring process for everyone.#J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Head Of Legal
description:

We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is simple but bold:to sequester gigatons of CO2while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast. Our company culture blends people-first care andperformance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive;
the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact. We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens. Check out our Culture page hereAbout the RoleWe are looking for a Head of Legal to strengthen and lead the legal function at InPlanet, acting as a strategic partner to the business in a highly complex, science-, operations- and contract-based environment. This role sits at the intersection of climate, mining, agriculture, and carbon markets, requiring someone who can connect legal, operational, and commercial perspectives across Brazil and international markets. This role is well suited to someone who has experience leading legal functions within a fast-growing, ambitious startup, or who has worked closely with startup ventures as a trusted legal advisor. investor relations from a legal standpoint- Build scalable legal processes, templates, and infrastructureYou can be a Rock-Star if you haveCore Skills & Experience- Law degree with active OAB registration (Brazil)- 8–15+ years of experience, ideally with strong exposure to environmental, operations or infrastructure-related sectors- Proven experience in:- Commercial and business law, ideally from a startup angle- Due diligence (legal & regulatory)- Complex contract structuring and negotiation- International contracts and cross-border operations- Strong background in business-oriented legal roles (e.G., General Counsel, senior associate in relevant practice areas)- Solid experience with:- Corporate law and governance- Investor relations and strategic partnerships- Fluency in English, with experience working in international environmentsKey Qualities- Business-oriented mindset: understands legal as a driver of growth- Highly relational: strong stakeholder management across cultures and functions- Strategic thinker: connects science, operations, and business into legal frameworks- Pragmatic and solution-driven: balances risk with execution speed- High ownership: comfortable operating as a senior, autonomous leader in a lean structure- Strong institutional presence: capable of representing the company externally- Structured and integrative: able to navigate and connect multiple regulatory domains- Neutral and sound judgment, especially in complex or sensitive mattersBonus Points (but not essential)- Experience in environmental, mining, agribusiness, or carbon markets- Background in startups, scale-ups, or boutique law firms- Exposure to governance and international structures- Postgraduate degree (LL.M., ESG, Business Law, etc.)- Business and legal experience in Germany- Speaks German- Based in a city with relatively easy access to Sao Paulo/SPLiving Our ValuesAt InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.- Trust: You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes- Drive: You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency- Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate changeBenefits- Compensation expectations and our compensation philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly.- Equity to feel like an owner- Home Office Budget- Fully Remote: Join us from anywhere within the CET (- 4/5-hour time zones).- Personal development budget- Language Programme Monthly Allowance- 40+ days annual leave- The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference and belong to a vision.- Occasional off-sites in Brazil yay!- Laptop to fuel your productivityInPlanet Compensation PhilosophyAt InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate. title: Pessoa Coordenadora De Estratégia De Redes Sociais - Influência E Produção | Marketing Produtos...
description:
Descrição da vagaSobre a área:A área é responsável pela gestão estratégica das redes sociais das marcas do Globoplay e de canais de variedades, entretenimento e esportivos do ecossistema Globo. Atua com as outras áreas de Marketing na conceituação e execução de planos de lançamento e sustentação dos projetos e campanhas alinhado aos objetivos de negócio de cada frente. Faz a gestão da relevância da presença das marcas nas plataformas com foco em engajamento com o consumidor, rentabilização e complementariedade de narrativas e públicos. Tem objetivo de criar estratégias que posicionem a Globo frente aos concorrentes dos territórios de Entretenimento, Esporte, Notícias e Streaming de forma inovadora, consistente e alinhado às mudanças de comportamento de consumo.Diversidade:Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.Modelo de trabalho:Híbrido: Rio de Janeiro, RJ.Responsabilidades e atribuiçõesComo será seu dia a dia:- Coordenar as frentes de Influência e Produção da área de Redes Sociais de Produtos Digitais;
- Liderar as campanhas de marketing de influência do Globoplay e dos canais esportivos e não esportivos da Globo;
- Atuar em parceria com outras lideranças na concepção, planejamento e gestão de projetos de lançamento e sustentação das marcas;
- Gerenciar o time de Produção, responsável por toda a cadeia de execução: pré-produção, atuação in loco e pós-produção;
- Garantir a entrega de conteúdos originais e coberturas de grandes eventos para os perfis do ecossistema;
- Liderar a gestão orçamentária das campanhas de influência e dos projetos de produção.Requisitos e qualificaçõesDo que você precisa:- Experiência em Marketing de Influência, com sólido conhecimento sobre a creator economy e o mercado de influenciadores, atuando estrategicamente na conexão entre marcas e creators;
- Vivência em planejamento e acompanhamento de produções de conteúdo audiovisual, com domínio de todas as etapas do processo, desde concepção criativa até execução e entrega final;
- Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de storytelling, sendo capaz de transformar ideias, informações e dados em narrativas estratégicas, relevantes e criativas para diferentes plataformas;
- Experiência na análisede métricas de redes sociais, utilizando dados e indicadores de performance para embasar tomadas de decisão estratégicas e otimização de resultados;
- Vivência na criação e proposição de soluções criativas, alinhadas às linguagens, tendências e referências das redes sociais, garantindo relevância cultural e engajamento;
- Perfil constantemente atento a novidades, insights e movimentos do mercado, contribuindo para o fortalecimento de um posicionamento de marca ousado, inovador e conectado às transformações digitais;
- Experiência na elaboração de apresentações estratégicas em PowerPoint, com clareza narrativa, organização de informações e foco em objetivos de negócio;
- Conhecimento e uso do Pacote Office, com destaque para Excel, aplicado à análise, organização e acompanhamento de dados e indicadores;
- Vivência na gestão de orçamentos de campanhas e produções, assegurando controle financeiro, eficiência de custos e otimização de recursos;
- Experiência em liderança e desenvolvimento de pessoas, com atuação direta na gestão, engajamento e evolução de equipes;
- Atuação colaborativa, com perfil inquieto, curioso e antenado às constantes transformações do mercado, contribuindo ativamente em ambientes multidisciplinares;
- Comunicação em inglês em nível avançado, com capacidade de conduzir interações profissionais, apresentações e análises no idioma.Conhecimentos que te destacam:- Conhecimento e atuação prévia com agências de influenciadores do mercado.Informações adicionaisPor que vir para Globo:Vem e vamos criar histórias e tecnologias juntos. Na Globo, o encontro de histórias com tecnologia move um time diverso e apaixonado por inovação. A gente tem a chance de aproximar os brasileiros, criando novas formas de se conectar com eles. Aqui, cada um faz a transformação acontecer.Os seus dados pessoais serão utilizados para fins de seleção de candidatos para preenchimento das vagas abertas na Globo. Os dados pessoais coletados durante o processo seletivo dos candidatos que não forem admitidos neste momento poderão ser mantidos nos bancos de dados para consideração em futuros processos seletivos. Todos os dados coletados serão tratados segundo rígidos padrões de segurança da informação e em total respeito às leis de privacidade aplicáveis, incluindo a Lei 13.709/18, e nos termos de nossa política de privacidade, disponível no link: prosseguir você está ciente e de acordo para realização de sua candidatura nestes termos.#J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Analista De Direitos Júnior | Direitos - Vaga Com Prazo Determinado
description:
Descrição da vagaA área de Direitos Esportivos é responsável por conduzir as negociações dos direitos de transmissão de todos os eventos esportivos — em diversas modalidades — para todas as plataformas e canais da Globo, além de manter o relacionamento com entidades nacionais e internacionais do setor.Com o desafio de garantir que os eventos estejam alinhados à estratégia da Globo e sejam adquiridos nas melhores condições de termos e valores, a área também conduz toda a gestão dos contratos do portfólio esportivo da empresa (seja do ponto de vista de exploração quanto de adequação do calendário à programação dos canais e fluxo financeiro), atuando de forma integrada com diversas áreas internas (canais, comercial, tecnologia, financeiro).Responsabilidades e atribuições- Apoiar a equipe de Direitos Esportivos com pesquisas e levantamentos de informações dos contratos e do mercado esportivo em geral;
- Apoiar a equipe de Direitos Esportivos para garantir a disseminação de informações relativas às negociações em andamento, aos contratos assinados, manuais e regulamentos dos eventos esportivos às diversas áreas, mediante preparação de resumos e relatórios (mapeamento de direitos, newsletters semanais, etc.);
- Esclarecer dúvidas e responder consultas de diversas áreas (incluindo, mas sem se limitar, aos direitos adquiridos e obrigações assumidas) por meio de informações dos contratos firmados;
- Apoiar a equipe de Direitos Esportivos nas demandas de contratos ao Jurídico e acompanhar a revisão dos documentos com as demais áreas da Globo.Requisitos e qualificações- Ensino Superior Completo em Administração, Direito ou áreas afins;
- Inglês Intermediário;
- Conhecimento avançado do Pacote Office (word, excel e ferramentas de apresentação);
- Excelente capacidade de relacionamento interpessoal, comunicação e organização;
- Gostar de trabalhar emequipe e de forma dinâmica;
- Estar aberto a aprender com o time e ter instinto colaborador.Conhecimentos que te destacam- Conhecimento do mercado esportivo e do cenário de mídia no Brasil e no exterior;
- Experiência com contratos e/ou negociação.#J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Auxiliar de Serviços Gerais – Externo
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

O profissional será responsável por executar atividades que exigem energia e disposição física, garantindo a manutenção, conservação e limpeza das áreas comuns do condomínio. Deverá zelar pelas instalações, assegurando que estejam sempre limpas, organizadas e em boas condições de uso.

Entre suas principais atribuições estão a limpeza das áreas internas e externas, incluindo varrição, coleta de lixo e higienização dos espaços. Também deverá atuar em ambientes abertos, com exposição ao sol e à chuva, realizando a limpeza de calçadas, jardins, garagens e demais áreas compartilhadas.

Sempre que necessário, irá auxiliar na separação de recicláveis e na coleta de resíduos, contribuindo para a correta destinação dos materiais. O foco é manter o ambiente limpo, seguro e agradável para os moradores, visitantes e demais colaboradores.

REQUISITOS DA VAGA

Ensino Fundamental completo; Experiência anterior na função (serviços gerais, limpeza ou conservação); Organização, proatividade e agilidade no desempenho das atividades; Diferencial: ter noções de manuseio de carrinhos, máquinas de limpeza ou equipamentos específicos do setor. BENEFÍCIOS DA VAGA

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

******TODAS AS NOSSAS VAGAS SÃO ELEGÍVEIS PARA PESSOAS COM DEFICIÊNCIA E REABILITADOS INSS.******

Auxiliar na higienização dos setores em geral, através de coleta interna de resíduo comum e reciclável, salvo biológico com precaução aérea e contato;
Auxiliar na higienização de banheiros, vidros, superfícies horizontais e verticais, como: mesa, bancada, parede, teto, cortinas, persianas e janelas varrendo e lavando a fim de manter as áreas limpas e organizadas;
Auxiliar na limpeza e no abastecimento das saboneteiras, papeleiras e produtos nos recipientes, repondo os materiais que estiverem acabando;
Abastecer e programar a Máquina de Lavar para com o objetivo manter limpos os panos e MOP´s;
Organizar as caixas com Kits de equipamentos de proteção individual, bem como auxiliar no preenchimento das fichas dos colaboradores do setor;
Organizar o estoque de Produtos de Higienização e Equipamentos, bem como, auxiliar na separação e distribuição do material para execução da higienização;
Organizar o carrinho funcional e/ou balaio de acordo com a padronização estabelecida pela Empresa;
Auxiliar na verificação das etiquetas de identificação e validade dos produtos conforme padrão estabelecido pela Empresa;
Executar atividades afins, de acordo com as suas competências, mediante solicitação do superior hierárquico.

title: Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation
description:
Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - OptimisationJoin or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation role at Canonical

Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation

1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation role at Canonical

Work across the full Linux stack from kernel through GUI to optimise Ubuntu, the world's most widely used Linux desktop and server, for the latest silicon.

The role is a fast-paced, problem-solving role that's challenging yet very exciting. The right candidate must be resourceful, articulate, and able to deliver on a wide variety of solutions across PC and IoT technologies. Our teams partner with specialist engineers from major silicon companies to integrate next-generation features and performance enhancements for upcoming hardware.

Location: This is a Globally remote role

What your day will look like

  • Design and implement the best Ubuntu integration for the latest IoT and server-class hardware platforms and software stacks
  • Work with partners to deliver a delightful, optimised, first class Ubuntu experience on their platforms
  • Take a holistic approach to the Ubuntu experience on partner platforms with inputs on technical plans, testing strategy, quality metrics
  • Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures from cloud to edge
  • Help our customers integrate their apps, SDKs, build device OS images, optimize applications with Ubuntu Core, Desktop and Server
  • Work with the most advanced operating systems and application technologies available in the enterprise world.

Joining Canonical, you will partner with bright minds from all over the world, and work with an exciting set of new technologies in a fast growing company with a truly unique and ambitious vision to build a better platform with free software. You will work with customers on exciting IoT and server platforms and technologies, built to support different verticals: from robots to data centers, from telco to retail.

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • You have experience with Linux packaging (Debian, RPM, Yocto)
  • You have experience working with open source communities and licences
  • You have experience working with C, C++
  • You can work in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation.

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

  • Experience with graphics stacks
  • Good understanding of networking - TCP/IP, DHCP, HTTP/REST
  • Basic understanding of security best practices in IoT or server environments
  • Good communication skills, ideally public speaking experience
  • IoT / Embedded experience – from board and SoC, BMCs, bootloaders and firmware to OS, through apps and services
  • Some experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.

  • Fully remote working environment - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at 'sprints'
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Já pensou em redirecionar sua carreira ou aprender uma nova profissão? Agora imagine só, poder fazer isso sendo parceiro de uma empresa que, há quase 200 anos, ajuda as pessoas a planejar um futuro financeiro mais tranquilo. Aqui na MAG, nossos corretores parceiros são chamados de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira . E se você tem tino comercial, gosta de se relacionar com pessoas, tem perfil empreendedor e deseja trabalhar com o forte propósito de prover soluções financeiras individuais nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros, nosso Programa para Formação de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira é a oportunidade ideal para você!

Vantagens de se tornar Especialistas em Proteção Financeira parceiro da MAG Seguros
  • Além de toda estrutura de suporte, treinamento e acompanhamento, poderemos apoiá-lo financeiramente na fase inicial de constituição de seu negócio, mediante o atingimento de critérios mínimos de produtividade.
  • Subsídios de até 70% para adquirir produtos como plano de saúde, de telefonia móvel, seguros de vida, notebook e smartphone, mediante elegibilidade ao nosso Programa de Fidelidade
  • Comissionamento vitalício sobre grande parte das coberturas comercializadas, ou seja, a comissão é do corretor pelo tempo em que o contrato do cliente estiver ativo, permitindo ganhos ilimitados.
  • Atuação presencial, com relacionamento multicanal, que pode ser realizado via unidades de vendas, telefone, WhatsApp, e-mail e chat, além de portal exclusivo para corretores.
  • Campanhas de vendas periódicas, que premiam os vencedores, além do reconhecimento e distinção, com incríveis viagens de turismo ou de desenvolvimento. Acesse vida.mag.com.br/mag-365.
  • Conversão das vendas em pontos que podem ser trocados por mais de 50 mil itens disponíveis em um catálogo virtual.
Responsabilidades e atribuições

Você atuará como profissional autônomo com as seguintes atribuições:

  • Inicialmente, se dedicará exclusivamente ao curso preparatório da MAG Universidade para obtenção da habilitação técnico profissional junto a Susep.

Após a conquista da Habilitação:

  • Identificará potenciais clientes para abordar, utilizando sua Rede de Relacionamento para agendamento de entrevistas de vendas e solicitação de indicações;
  • Fará telemarketing ativo para agendar entrevistas de vendas;
  • Realizará as entrevistas de vendas, identificando as necessidades de proteção financeira do prospect e ofertando as soluções mais adequadas a cada perfil;
  • Gerenciará a sua carteira de clientes com foco na sustentabilidade financeira do seu negócio.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Aptidão para vendas;
  • Amplo círculo social (network/ rede de relacionamento);
  • Perfil ativo nas redes sociais;
Você se diferenciará, se possuir:
  • Experiência como profissional autônomo, liberal ou empreendedor;
  • Experiência com venda consultiva e rotina de vendas externas.
Informações adicionais PESSOAS BEM-SUCEDIDAS NESSA PROFISSÃO
  • São aguerridas, motivadas, resilientes e persistentes, dedicando à construção do sucesso de seu próprio negócio;
  • Identificam-se com o propósito de despertar nas pessoas o desejo e a necessidade de assegurar o próprio futuro e o das pessoas que amam;
  • Possuem ampla rede de relacionamento, frequentam grupos sociais ligados a esporte, religião, hobbies, culinária, educação, negócios ou qualquer outro tema que permita estar em contato frequente com diferentes pessoas, ampliando o círculo social;
  • Possuem como prioridades o sucesso profissional e os ganhos financeiros, independente de regime de contratação de trabalho;
  • Têm disponibilidade para atuar conforme agenda do cliente, possuindo flexibilidade na rotina de trabalho, para atendimento além dos horários convencionais;
  • Atuam com disciplina no planejamento semanal das atividades de vendas, de acordo com os parâmetros necessários para o atingimento e superação dos objetivos financeiros e pessoais;
  • Dedicam-se ao estudo contínuo em busca de novos conhecimentos, mantendo-se atualizadas profissionalmente.

We Are Looking For a Person Who Has
  • At least 10 years of experience developing digital products in complex environments

  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and raising the technical bar across organizations

This is a high‑impact role where you will be the ringleader for one of Mode's most successful mobile apps, driving millions of users and ~$10 M / yr in revenue. Your success can help create blueprints for aggressive expansion through in‑house products and M&A, opening opportunities across the portfolio.

At The Coca-Cola Company, we are proud to be one of the world’s most recognized and respected brands, with a legacy spanning over 139 years and a portfolio of more than 200 brands enjoyed by millions globally. Our mission is simple yet powerful: refresh the world and make a difference.

We are seeking a Director, Scientific & Regulatory Affairs (SRA) Brazil to provide scientific and regulatory leadership across one of our most strategically important markets. This role is pivotal in protecting and expanding the Company’s freedom to operate by ensuring portfolio compliance, enabling innovation, and actively shaping the external regulatory environment through science‑based advocacy . The ideal candidate will bring deep scientific expertise, strong regulatory judgment, and the ability to influence policy and business decisions through credibility and collaboration.

If you are passionate about science‑led advocacy, regulatory leadership, and enabling responsible growth, we want you on our team.

What You’ll Do For Us
  • Lead the execution of the Scientific & Regulatory Affairs agenda for Brazil, aligning scientific, regulatory, and advocacy activities with business priorities and regional and global SRA direction.
  • Engage in science‑based regulatory advocacy, contributing technical expertise and evidence to help shape policies, standards, and guidance that impact the Company’s portfolio and future innovation.
  • Serve as the scientific and regulatory authority for claims and marketing communications evaluation and approval, ensuring compliance, credibility, and appropriate substantiation.
  • Ensure compliance continuity across the full portfolio after product launch.
  • Partner closely with Marketing, R&D, Legal, Public Affairs, and Franchise teams to anticipate regulatory risks and enable compliant, timely business decisions.
  • Monitor and assess emerging scientific, regulatory, and public policy trends, translating complexity into clear implications and recommendations for senior leaders.
  • Support the market on IMCRs (Incident Management and Crisis Response), providing scientific and regulatory expertise to enable effective, timely, and compliant responses.
  • Represent the Company with regulators, industry associations, and scientific forums as appropriate, building credibility and constructive dialogue.
Requirements & Qualifications
  • Advanced degree in Food Science, Nutrition, Toxicology, Chemistry, Biology, Public Health, or a related scientific discipline.
  • 10+ years of experience in scientific and/or regulatory affairs within food, beverage, consumer goods, pharmaceutical, or similarly regulated industries.
  • Strong knowledge of Brazilian regulatory frameworks, with demonstrated experience engaging with ANVISA and other relevant authorities.
  • Proven expertise in regulatory advocacy, claims substantiation, labeling, marketing communications review, and product compliance across the product life cycle.
  • Ability to influence cross‑functional and external stakeholders in a matrixed organization without direct people management responsibility.
  • Strong judgment, analytical thinking, and comfort operating in complex, evolving regulatory environments.
  • Experience working in emerging markets and within global organizations strongly preferred.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English; Spanish proficiency is a plus.
What We'll Do For You
  • Global Exposure: Collaborate with regional and global SRA leaders, contributing Brazilian perspectives to enterprise‑level scientific and regulatory strategies.
  • Iconic Brands: Support some of the world’s most trusted and loved brands within a system grounded in science, integrity, and responsibility.
  • Learning & Development: Access continuous scientific learning, regulatory forums, and professional development opportunities.
  • Purpose‑Driven Work: Play a meaningful role in advancing science‑based policy and enabling sustainable, responsible business growth.
Skills

Regulatory Environment; Leadership; Strategic Influence; Regulatory Advocacy; Regulatory Issues; organization; Analytical Thinking; Active Listening; Food Sciences; Food Technology; Risk Management; Communication; Government Affairs; Regulatory Policies; Taking Initiative; Cross-Functional Teamwork

title: Vice President, Business Development
description:
Job Description

The Vice President Business Development individually drives market position and achievement of business outcomes through the Demand and Account Management/Commercial Operations Core Process. This position is a senior level, core sales position within the company responsible for new business/clients as well as managing/leveraging existing accounts. The Vice President Business Development drives results through individual and collective team sales efforts. The position is responsible for leveraging collaboration with internal teams such as marketing, engineering/survey, and product development and technology groups in order to drive service and business outcomes. The Vice President Business Development also contributes to strategic initiatives and planning through an extensive knowledge of market conditions within their assigned specific location or group of locations, country or group of countries, market sector, and/or product(s).

What You Will Do:
  • Execute and drive sales strategies in the assigned area of responsibility and meet or exceed sales and revenue targets with a focus on the marine area.
  • Support the Product & Digital Solution Development, Survey & Certification, Engineering Delivery, and Rule Development Core Processes as needed to achieve organizational business outcomes.
  • Develop and maintain key client relationships with a focus on maintaining current work and expanding new business opportunities and prospect for new clients and business opportunities within your assigned responsibility in marine sector.
  • Lead the development of visit plans for assigned clients and area of responsibility, to include organizing client meetings for ABS senior management.
  • Execute the Demand and Account Management / Commercial Operations Core Process as appropriate within the assigned area of responsibility.
  • Maintains awareness of the overall ABS service portfolio and promote services/products when appropriate, ensuring peers and teams outside your core responsibility are aware of potential opportunities and needed action.
  • Provide strategic insight within the assigned area or responsibility related to future business initiatives, market drivers, and competitor activities for inclusion in business planning.
  • Work with organizational teams to develop capture strategies, proposals and pricing as appropriate.
  • Work with technical staff and other internal teams as needed to meet customer needs.
  • Attend industry events and conferences, and provide feedback and information on market and creative trends.
  • Identify opportunities for marketing campaigns within the area of responsibility that will lead to increased sales.
  • Submit reports as needed and ensure data is accurately entered and managed within the company’s CRM.
  • Forecast sales targets and track activity on accounts to meet these targets.
What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business or in an engineering technical field is required.
  • MBA or engineering postgraduate degree is preferred.
  • Over 20 years of experience in marine sector.
  • Typically 7 or more years of experience in the assigned area of responsibility or market sector is required.
  • International experience, either as an expatriate or working with international projects and teams, is required.
  • Previous experience in business development or sales in a technical and diverse product environment is preferred.
Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities
  • Demonstrated acumen for sales, business development, and account management with experience in meeting and/or exceeding sales targets preferred.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in developing strategic customer relationships.
  • Strong leadership presence and the ability to quickly establish and build credibility and relationships, externally as well as internally to ABS.
  • Excellent business judgment, including the ability to assess the reasonableness and likelihood of success of various business scenarios.
  • Demonstrated technical acumen related to the product or area of responsibility.
  • A self-starter with a demonstrated desire achieve goals and as well as a collaborative personality who effectively works with teams and individuals to achieve organizational business outcomes.
Reporting Relationships:

Reports directly to the Senior Vice President.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times. ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We’re at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting‑edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever‑present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento doagronegócio , por meio de suas controladasFartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% daCHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (”FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup™ (”FWWC”).

The Head of Commercial Partnerships has responsibility, under the leadership of FIFA’s Director Commercial Partnerships and the operational guidance of the Brazil Entity Chief Operations Officers, for the successful implementation and coordination of the commercial revenue programs for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

This cross-functional position plays a critical role in planning, managing and implementing Host Country commercial revenues activities related to sponsorship sales, partnership management & partner rights delivery and commercial operations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • In close cooperation with FIFA’s Commercial Partnerships department, manage the day-to-day implementation plans in relation to the Tournament’s commercial partnerships programs, as well as manage relevant local sales agencies and service providers.
  • Working with Relevant Department Heads from FIFA, lead the Host Country commercial partnerships staff across sponsorship sales, partnership management and partner rights delivery.
  • Work with FIFA Commercial Partnerships Sub-Division and Host Country to shape integrated plans and strategies, including relevant sales and operational plans.
  • Working closely with the FIFA Partnership Sales team, ensure the effective delivery of the Tournament’s sponsorship sales with a focus on regional sponsorships in host country.
  • Identify and develop strong relationships with potential key sponsors and agencies in the host country and wider region, proactively lead on contract negotiations, and contribute to maintaining strong and effective relationships with sponsors.
  • Manage the regional sponsorship sales process in accordance with the defined timetable and priorities and negotiate agreements across relevant markets.
  • In close alignment with FIFA Partnership Management team, contribute to building strong and successful relationships with FIFA partners.
  • Working closely with FIFA Partner Rights Delivery team in Zurich and with the support of a local team, deliver all commercial operations as per the rights granted to Commercial Partners for the competition and competition-related events and sites.
  • In close collaboration with the FIFA Partner Rights Delivery team in Zurich and Brazil, ensure successful implementation of the public Food & Beverage (F&B) concessions programme across all stadiums.
  • Manage and support a talented team of individuals, located at Brazil HQ across all commercial partnerships and licensing projects.
YOUR PROFILE
  • 10+ years of international commercial experience in sport
  • Proven experience within global sports / Rights Holder environment
  • Proven track record managing major commercial programs across sponsorship sales, partnership management and commercial operations
  • Proven and successful track record in opening, negotiating and closing significant multi-year, multi-million sponsorship deals
  • Knowledge of commercial operations in major event settings and/or the sports industry
  • Experienced negotiator and ability to manage complex and lengthy processes
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build and maintain effective working relationships across multiple teams and at varying levels
  • Experience and knowledge of local markets and culture
  • Ability to work in a matrixed environment
  • Ability to hire, develop, coach, appraise and retain qualified employees
  • Experience of managing multi-disciplined teams across a variety of business areas
  • Capacity to make key decisions for the business through critical problem-solving skills and an ability to use sound judgement
  • Creative and strategic thinker from a diverse background
  • Proficient in preparing and managing budgets
  • Proven organisational skills with excellent attention to detail, particularly under pressure
  • Solid operational and strategic marketing knowledge/experience
  • Operational knowledge and experience in major international events, preferably sports events
  • Passion for sport

Requirements

  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)

SOBRE NÓS!

Fundado por portugueses nos anos 50 com o nome “Casas Guanabara”, o pequeno comércio se transformou no Supermercados Guanabara, uma das mais tradicionais e modernas redes do país. Atualmente possui 28 lojas distribuídas no Rio, Grande Rio, Baixada Fluminense e Região Metropolitana, dois centros de distribuição e dois depósitos.

Para garantir a melhor experiência de compras para os seus clientes, prezando pelo conforto e segurança, as unidades contam com piso antiderrapante, rampas de acesso para facilitar a circulação, corredores amplos, grande quantidade de check-outs, estacionamento inteligente, além de um mix diferenciado para atender a qualquer orçamento.

E não para por aí!

A rede de Supermercados Guanabara seguindo a tendência mundial do setor supermercadista implantou nas lojas a captação da água da chuva e do sistema de ar-condicionado, com reúso nos banheiros e lavagem das lojas. A iluminação tem a tecnologia led e um projeto arquitetônico que inclui fachada de vidro para evitar o desperdício de energia.

Você sabia que a rede inovou e levou o shopping para dentro do supermercado? Atualmente várias unidades Guanabara possui centro comercial com lojas de serviço e grandes magazines. Algumas lojas operam com sistema store in store, orientação de sommelier na hora da escolha de vinhos.

O Guanabara também inovou no calendário varejista do estado do Rio de Janeiro e criou campanhas promocionais como: Semana da Beleza, Semana da Limpeza, Guanababy, Black Fraldas e o tradicional Aniversário Guanabara!

A rede já foi eleita pela revista Veja Rio como "A marca mais amada do Rio" e por 15 anos pela pesquisa “Marcas dos Cariocas”, em parceria com O Globo, a "Marca preferida dos Cariocas" .

E você sabe qual o segredo de todo esse sucesso? São os 14 mil talentos que compõem esse time campeão.
